[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/01/24 (Tue) 10:22

[ASSISTANT_SAID] To put your controller behind an API Gateway, you need to configure your application to work with the API Gateway.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Configure HTTPS using the `ConfigureWebHostDefaults` method of the `Program` class by adding the `UseHttps` method.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example code for configuring HTTPS:
```csharp
public static void Main(string[] args)
{
    CreateHostBuilder(args).Build().Run();
}

public static IHostBuilder CreateHostBuilder(string[] args) =>
    Host.CreateDefaultBuilder(args)
        .ConfigureWebHostDefaults(webBuilder =>
        {
            webBuilder.UseStartup<Startup>()
                .UseUrls("https://localhost:5001")
                .UseHttps();
        });
```

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Configure the API Gateway to forward requests to your application, specifying the hostname, port, and path to your controller.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: Configure routing in the `Configure` method of the `Startup` class to handle modified paths.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example code for configuring routing:
```csharp
public void Configure(IApplicationBuilder app, IWebHostEnvironment env)
{
    // ...

    app.UseRouting();

    app.UseEndpoints(endpoints =>
    {
        endpoints.MapControllerRoute(
            name: "default",
            pattern: "{controller}/{action}/{id?}");
    });
}
```

[ASSISTANT_SAID] By default, ASP.NET Core applications listen on `localhost` and are not accessible from outside the host machine. You need to listen on a publicly accessible IP address and configure your firewall to allow traffic.

[USER] Please generate the complete Program.cs.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Example of a complete `Program.cs` file for a .NET 6.0 web API project:
```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;

namespace YourProjectName
{
    public class Program
    {
        public static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            CreateHostBuilder(args).Build().Run();
        }

        public static IHostBuilder CreateHostBuilder(string[] args) =>
            Host.CreateDefaultBuilder(args)
                .ConfigureWebHostDefaults(webBuilder =>
                {
                    webBuilder.UseStartup<Startup>();
                });
    }
}
```

[ASSISTANT_SAID] This file sets up the `Main` method to create a web host builder using the `CreateDefaultBuilder` method.

[USER] If I want to use Keycloak for authentication, what need to be modified?

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Install the `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.OpenIdConnect` package.
